LanguageData.LP_EnhanceGearLow.label: enchant (+1 to +5)
LanguageData.LP_EnhanceGearLow.description: Enhance a weapon or apparel with an enhancement target chosen by one level, up to +5. Each attempt uses 4 mithril and 25 silver. Success: +1 100%, +2 95%, +3 90%, +4 80%, +5 70%; +1.5% for each level the average of Intellectual and Crafting exceeds 8 (up to +18%), another +5% when linked to an arcane focus stone. Failure only loses the materials. The gear must be on the ground or in a storage zone; worn gear won't be taken for enhancement.
LanguageData.LP_EnhanceGearHigh.label: enchant (+6 to +10)
LanguageData.LP_EnhanceGearHigh.description: Enhance a weapon or apparel that is already +5 or higher and has an enhancement target chosen by one more level, up to +10. Each attempt uses 4 adamantine and 10 gold. Success: +6 60%, +7 50%, +8 40%, +9 30%, +10 20%; skill and arcane focus stone bonuses as for the lower tiers. Failure from +6 upward drops the gear one level (never below +5).
